kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.malam.0: Evening. Listen to the river; it tells stories.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.malam.1: Old folk like me sleep with one eye open.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.malam.2: That star, the bright one, is this village's ancestor.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.malam.3: Cold tonight; my knees already told me.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.malam.4: Do not wander too far at night.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.pagi.0: Morning, young one. Your steps are still strong.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.pagi.1: I was up before the moon set. The old need little sleep.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.pagi.2: Morning tea, a little ginger, no complaints.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.pagi.3: Morning. I have lit incense for the ancestors.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.pagi.4: The dew is sweet today. The harvest will be good.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.siang.0: On afternoons like this I used to carry two sacks of rice at once.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.siang.1: Sit, young one; my legs are older than this road.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.siang.2: I planted this tree's shade when I was little.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.siang.3: Children these days walk too fast.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.siang.4: Afternoon. Chess? I will surely win.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.takut.0: P-please forgive us... we will repair it ourselves.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.takut.1: This village has nothing of value, sir.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.takut.2: Take the rice, but do not touch the children.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.takut.3: I am old; punish me, not the village.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.tetua.takut.4: I have not been this afraid in seventy years.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.buronan.0: (whispering) That is the one whose face is on the Yamen board.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.buronan.1: Keep away, or the guards will question us too.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.buronan.2: Pretend you did not see, pretend you did not see...
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.buronan.3: You had better go to the Yamen and pay your fine.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.buronan.4: I want no part of this.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.buronan.5: The reward for your head is decent, you know.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.buronan.6: Shut the windows! Wanted one passing!
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.buronan.7: The Yamen painter drew your nose too big.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.buronan.8: Do not know you, do not know you.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.dagang.0: Have a look first, sir, no need to buy.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.dagang.10: One chip cheaper than the next stall!
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.dagang.3: Cheap, cheap, for today's first customer!
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.dagang.4: Haggle if you like, just not in tears.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.dagang.5: Buy two, get a free smile.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.dagang.7: Goods from afar, carried with great toil!
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.dagang.9: You have a keen eye, sir, I can tell.
The lanterns are so lovely this year.
No one quarrels today, they say.
The music makes my feet dance on their own.
The fireworks will be over the wall later!
Next year I will dance too.
Release a lantern and make a wish.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.hujan.10: The sky is weeping. Who upset it?
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.hujan.11: The market empties in the rain; the merchants grumble.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.hujan.2: Rain like this is good for the paddies.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.hujan.3: My roof leaks right above the bed.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.hujan.5: The smell of wet earth; I love it.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.hujan.7: The wind tore my paper umbrella.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.hujan.8: Rain, rain, go to the mountains.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.hujan.9: Soaked! Lucky I was not carrying a book.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.kagum.0: Your aura is like a mountain. My respects!
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.kagum.1: A cultivator this high, visiting us?
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.kagum.10: Please, please, take the best seat!
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.kagum.11: Is it true you can fly on a sword?
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.kagum.2: Look, their robe moves without wind.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.kagum.3: Tell us a little about your tribulation!
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.kagum.4: May my child greet you? They want to be like you.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.kagum.5: Your steps make no sound. Amazing.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.kagum.6: This must be an elder of a great sect.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.kagum.7: My eyes water looking at you, like staring at the sun.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.kagum.8: The air feels fresher since you came.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.kagum.9: I will tell my grandchildren I once saw you.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.keluhan.0: Taxes went up again this month.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.keluhan.1: My back has hurt since yesterday.
There are more flies at the market than buyers.
My in-laws are visiting again. For a week.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.keluhan.2: The neighbour's kids never stop shouting.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.keluhan.3: The price of rice has gone mad.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.keluhan.4: My cat has been missing three days.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.keluhan.6: Why do all cultivators walk so fast?
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.keluhan.7: I sleep badly; strange dreams all the time.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.keluhan.8: My knees predict rain, and my knees are always right.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.keluhan.9: My wages have not risen since the dragon year.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.malam.0: Evening, sir. Avoid the dark alleys.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.malam.10: I lock my door twice at night.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.malam.11: You do not sleep? Cultivators are strange.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.malam.2: It is late; I am heading home.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.malam.5: Hear the crickets? The season is turning.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.malam.6: A night like this calls for warm wine.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.malam.7: Careful; night brings strange people out.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.malam.8: So many stars. Tomorrow will be clear.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.malam.9: Evening. The watch has struck the first clapper.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.pagi.10: Good morning. A clear sky, a good omen.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.pagi.11: Out walking so early? How diligent.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.pagi.2: A fine morning for a long walk.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.pagi.3: The neighbour's rooster crowed before dawn again.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.pagi.4: Morning. The streets are still quiet; lovely.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.pagi.5: The ginger porridge down the road is ready, smell it?
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.pagi.6: May your day go smoothly, honoured cultivator.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.pagi.7: The sun is barely up and I am already tired. Impressive, no?
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.pagi.8: Morning! The birds are so noisy today.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.pagi.9: The mist on the hill has not lifted. Mind the road.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.siang.0: So hot this noon. Find some shade, sir.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.siang.1: Afternoon. Eaten yet? The place over there is good.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.siang.11: Half the day is gone; the other half is still long.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.siang.2: The sun is right overhead; my shadow is gone.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.siang.3: An afternoon like this is made for napping under a tree.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.siang.6: They say even ghosts stay in at high noon.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.siang.7: The road dust gets right up your nose.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.siang.8: Afternoon. Cold tea next door, only five chips.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.siang.9: The afternoon wind is too lazy to blow.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.takut.10: Heavens, do not let them be angry...
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.takut.11: I... I do not know you. Never did.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.takut.4: I am only a small person, sir.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.takut.6: N-no one dares send you a bill, rest easy.
kultivator.cerita.kalimat.umum.takut.9: We will repair it ourselves, truly!
